bias.zh: 反弹减弱 · 跌破 10 日均线，守住 $195–197

read.en: Coherent fell 6.7% on Nov 16 to $203.43, trading $196.12–208.15. It is below the 5-day ($220.6), 10-day ($209.3), 30-day ($239.0), 100-day ($285.4) and 200-day ($296.8). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 10, below zero, histogram easing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($172.51), and RSI is 42.3.

The drop broke the 10-day and the $207–209 support (Nov 10 and 13 lows), now resistance; the $196.12 low held the $195.1–197.2 zone (Nov 4 close, Nov 9 low). Resistance is $207.1–209.3, then $214.7–218.2 (Nov 10 and 13 closes) and $220.6–225.2. Support is $195.1–197.2, then $192.8 (Nov 6 close) and $169.8–172.5 (Nov 5 close, SAR). A close above $209.3 would target $214.7–218; below $195, $192.8.
